factionMagicItems.name: The Tomb Blade of Arkhan
factionMagicItems.rules: If the bearer has joined Zombies, Skeletons, Tomb Guard or Wight infantry, add a new model whenever the bearer kills a man-sized enemy with this blade. New models do not fight in the melee phase in which they are added.

factionMagicItems.name: Sword of Kings
factionMagicItems.rules: Wights only. Each wound becomes 1D6 wounds. No armour save.

factionMagicItems.name: Ring of Night Creatures
factionMagicItems.rules: Vampires only. All Giant Wolves and Giant Bats become Stubborn using the bearer’s Leadership.

faction.name: Vampire Counts
armyWideRules: All Vampires in the army must belong to the same bloodline.
Each bloodline power is unique within the army and is not cancelled by effects that cancel magic items.
The general need not be a Vampire and the army may contain no Vampires.

von_carstein.name: Wolf Form
von_carstein.rules: Movement Allowance 9. May join Giant Wolves and receive a Look Out, Sir roll.

von_carstein.name: Transfix
von_carstein.rules: Enemies in base contact must pass a Leadership test or will not strike the Vampire; does not affect models immune to psychology.

von_carstein.name: Dark Majesty
von_carstein.rules: +1 combat resolution. If taken by the general, all undead units within 18 inches may march.

von_carstein.name: Summon Wolves
von_carstein.rules: One use only. Summons 1D6+1 Giant Wolves at a randomly determined table edge at the start of a Vampire turn; they may move but not charge.

von_carstein.name: Call Storm
von_carstein.rules: One use only. For one complete turn BS shooting is -2, other shooting only works on 4+, and flying is impossible.

lahmian.name: Mist Form
lahmian.rules: May fly up to 20 inches, except when charging into melee combat.

lahmian.name: Transfix
lahmian.rules: Enemies in base contact must pass a Leadership test or will not strike the Vampire; does not affect models immune to psychology.

lahmian.name: Beguile
lahmian.rules: Living enemies within 8 inches suffer -1 Leadership.

lahmian.name: Death’s Pale Beauty
lahmian.rules: Living enemies suffer -1 to hit the Vampire in melee combat.

lahmian.name: Domination
lahmian.rules: Enemies in base contact must pass a Leadership test or cannot strike in melee combat and are hit automatically; no effect on models immune to psychology.

necrarch.name: Dark Acolyte
necrarch.rules: Counts as one extra magic level without gaining the extra spell.

necrarch.name: Dark Summoner
necrarch.rules: May replace a spell with Raise the Dead and raises an extra 1D6 Skeletons or Zombies with specified raising spells.

necrarch.name: Master of the Black Arts
necrarch.rules: May take an extra personal magic card each magic phase.

blood_dragon.name: Terrifying Challenger
blood_dragon.rules: Enemy characters challenged by the Vampire must pass a Leadership test or refuse and hide if possible; no effect on models immune to psychology.

blood_dragon.name: Beast Slayer
blood_dragon.rules: When fighting with mundane weapons, each wound caused multiplies into 1D3 wounds.

blood_dragon.name: Martial Excellence
blood_dragon.rules: +1 to hit on all melee attacks.

strigoi.name: Lord of the Beasts
strigoi.rules: All Giant Wolves and Giant Bats become Stubborn using the Vampire’s Leadership.

strigoi.name: Blood Gorger
strigoi.rules: After breaking or wiping out a living enemy, may feed instead of pursuing and recover one lost wound; not while frenzied.

strigoi.name: Killer Instinct
strigoi.rules: Each wound caused multiplies into 1D3 wounds.

strigoi.name: Malignant Envy
strigoi.rules: May re-roll all failed attacks each combat round.

strigoi.name: Summon Ghouls
strigoi.rules: One use only. Summon 1D6+2 Ghouls at a randomly determined table edge; they may move but not charge.

strigoi.name: Hell Beast
strigoi.rules: +1 Wound, can fly, uses a 40x40 base and may join Giant Bats with Look Out, Sir.

regiments.name: Ghasts
rules: Unbreakable in combat while the undead side outnumbers the enemy
Must gorge after winning a combat in which the enemy suffered a casualty; cannot pursue or overrun

warMachines.name: Banshee
rules: Ghostly Howl: in the shooting phase, even after marching, target a living non-deaf enemy within 8 inches; it suffers 2D6+2 minus its Leadership wounds with no armour save.

specialCharacters.name: Vlad and Isabella von Carstein
rules: Vlad is a level 2 wizard and carries the Carstein Ring and Dark Majesty; Isabella has Transfix.
Vlad and Isabella must stay together and try to reunite if separated.
If one is killed permanently, the other gains Frenzy and Hatred.

Carstein Ring: one use; if Vlad is killed he returns within 12 inches with one wound, but loses equipment and magic items; spells and bloodline powers remain, and this prevents army crumble from the general’s death.

specialCharacters.name: Mannfred von Carstein
rules: May take four magic items or bloodline powers in any combination.

specialCharacters.name: Konrad von Carstein
rules: May take two magic items or bloodline powers.
